title: [Expense Agent] Grant policy builder execute permission
summary: Expense Management roles now have execute permission on the policy builder codeunit to prevent access denied errors when calculating policy status on the Expense Report subpage.
key_points: Added execute permission for codeunit 7107 (Exp. Policies To Eval Builder) to Expense Management - Objects permission set
Fixes DB:ExecuteObjDenied error when Expense Report SubPage calculates policy status
Issue occurred because policy builder calls happened without necessary permissions for interactive users
Includes test coverage to verify the permission grant
Validated using automated permission verification script
